newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Indosuez unit ups stake in Malaysia broker.
newsitem.headline: Indosuez unit ups stake in Malaysia broker.

text.p: WI Carr (Malaysia) Sdn Bhd, a unit of France's Banque Indosuez, said on Tuesday it has increased its stake in Malaysian stockbroker Seagroatt & Campbell Holdings Bhd.
In a statement, stockbroker WI Carr said it has raised its stake to 30 percent from 25 by buying three million shares in the open market.
WI Carr Malaysia managing director Patrick Russell said the company paid about $10 million or roughly 22-24 million ringgit for the Seagroatt shares.
At 22-24 million ringgit, WI Carr would have paid about 7.33 to 8.00 ringgit a share for its additional stake.
At 0756 GMT, Seagroatt shares were at 7.65 ringgit, down 10 cents.
